findings.issue: readHeadCellSource checks path components with lstat and then opens the path separately with fs.readFile, leaving a symlink-swap race.
findings.reason: A path component or final file can be replaced after the checks and before the read, allowing a caller to read outside the fixed artifact paths. The profile-artifact reader uses an opened file handle and verifies its device/inode against the checked file; this reader does not.
findings.fix: Open with O_NOFOLLOW, then verify the opened file is regular and matches the checked device/inode before reading. Consider applying the same handle-based checks to each path component or otherwise preventing directory-component swaps.

findings.issue: readHeadCellSource does not validate maxBytes before using it as a size limit.
findings.reason: Because the function is exported, a caller can pass NaN or Infinity; the stat.size > maxBytes checks then do not enforce the intended read bound, potentially allowing an oversized artifact to be read into memory.
findings.fix: Require maxBytes to be a positive safe integer within a fixed maximum before path inspection or reading.
